Definition: of Chaldee origin (H1247 and H3124); son of Jonas (or Jonah); Bar-jonas, an Israelite:--Bar-jona.
BiblicalUsage: Bar-jona is the name Jesus gives Simon when He blesses him. He calls him Simon Bar-jona, the son of Jonah, in the moment Peter confesses that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the living God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus names Peter by his father in the very breath that He names him blessed, because the confession did not come from flesh and blood but from the Father in heaven.
